page_title: OSA 1-1 RAY | Osasuna v Rayo Vallecano 19/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Alejandro Ruiz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.

90+1' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
90+1' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for holding. Alejandro Ruiz signals a set piece.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Kike Barja (Osasuna) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
87' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
87' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Isi Palazon.
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Adrian Embarba walks off the pitch to be replaced by Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano).
86' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 49:51. The total number of attempts is 10:7. Shots on target – 3:3.
84' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
84' A corner kick by Osasuna is thwarted by the well prepared Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano). The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
81' Vicente Moreno has decided to substitute Jon Moncayola and he is replaced by Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
81' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
81' Alejandro Ruiz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jesus Areso (Osasuna) and blew his whistle.
81' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kike Barja (Osasuna) comes onto the pitch so that Ruben Garcia can be given a rest.
74' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
74' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) blows a great chance. He unleashes a shot from inside the box, but the effort rattles the left post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
73' Sergio Herrera reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) low towards the middle of the goal.
73' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) will take the free kick.
72' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
72' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Rayo Vallecano earn a free kick.
68' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Sergio Camello will be replaced by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano).
68' It is time for a substitution. Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) is on for Unai Lopez.

67' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) finishes his astonishing individual effort with a great shot from about 50 metres to the top of the net. Sergio Herrera shows his excellent skills and pushes the attempt onto the bar.

66' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and produces a header that goes not far wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
66' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) will take a corner kick.
66' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee points to the corner flag and Osasuna will take a corner.
64' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
64' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Osasuna get a corner.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Jorge de Frutos.

59' 1 - 1 Ruben Garcia sends a superb cross into the box. Raul Garcia (Osasuna) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the right post, leaving Augusto Batalla beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:1.
58' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
57' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
57' The ball is out of play. Osasuna win a corner kick.
56' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. It will be a corner kick for Osasuna.
53' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Augusto Batalla makes a save.
52' The attendance for today's match is 20770.
51' A rebound falls kindly for Jon Moncayola (Osasuna), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
50' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
49' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Osasuna have a free kick.
49' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
46' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

46' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. Now Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
46' Half-time substitution. Juan Cruz (Osasuna) will not participate anymore and Abel Bretones is coming on.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Vicente Moreno gives a chance to Raul Garcia and Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
40' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
40' Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna). Free kick. Rayo Vallecano will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
38' The booking goes to Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano).
38' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle. Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul after dangerous play. Osasuna get a free kick.
37' A raking crossfield pass from Jesus Areso (Osasuna) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
36' The ball goes out for a corner. Osasuna can continue in their attacking effort.
34' The corner is flicked onto Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano), but his close-range header flies a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
33' Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.

32' What a great touch by Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Rayo Vallecano.
32' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Osasuna, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
26' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
19' 0 - 1 GOAL - 0:1! Andrei Ratiu found Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Sergio Herrera off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
17' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Sergio Herrera.
16' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) brings an opponent down and Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
13' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
5' The game is interrupted now, Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
3' The ball goes out of play. Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Osasuna will kick-off.
Alejandro Ruiz will supervise the game today.
